remote_accounting: Every live job: full worst-case raw plus temporary output reservation
Every completed job: raw tree plus delta and partial archives
All older retained jobs and collected-but-not-yet-backed-up remote originals
Any active staging, packing or transfer scratch
local_accounting: Staging/recovery requires its own measured peak plus all concurrent reservations and10GiB untouched
Serial collection requires actual measured expanded, archive, Git/backup and recovery peaks plus all concurrent reservations and10GiB untouched
remaining: Exact source packages and measured remote/staging/recovery bindings must pass final review before submission.
